page_title: VAL 0-0 OSA | Valencia v Osasuna 24/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Valencia players are visibly unhappy with the call.

90+3' Play continues despite the shouts by some Valencia players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
90+2' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+2' That looked a certain handball by Ante Budimir (Osasuna) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) earns the yellow card.
86' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valencia.
85' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Ante Budimir (Osasuna) who loops his header high over the bar.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sergi Canos (Valencia) will replace Dani Gomez.
84' Osasuna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
77' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ruben Pena as he is replaced by Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna).
74' Here is a change. Thierry Correia is going off and Ruben Baraja gives the last tactical orders to Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia).
74' The substitution has been made. Hugo Duro (Valencia) has replaced Diego Lopez.
72' One of the players from Osasuna times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
70' Yellow card. Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
68' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows a yellow card to Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) for his blatant foul.
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valencia comes to nothing.
63' The game has come to an end for Aimar Oroz. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ruben Garcia (Osasuna).
63' That will be all from Raul Garcia who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ante Budimir (Osasuna).
62' Ruben Baraja has decided to substitute Enzo Barrenechea and he is replaced by Javi Guerra (Valencia).
62' Andre Almeida will be replaced by Fran Perez (Valencia).
61' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
59' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
54' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucas Torro (Osasuna) was quite harsh and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
53' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
53' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Valencia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' The free kick is delivered by Moi Gomez (Osasuna) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
50' Valencia take a short corner kick.
49' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
47' Diego Lopez (Valencia) is caught offside!
46' Vicente Moreno has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Pablo Ibanez comes on the pitch for Jon Moncayola (Osasuna).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) is given a yellow card.
45+1' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45' Valencia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
42' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) takes a first-time shot from inside the box, but his poor effort flies way wide of the right post.
41' A free kick on the edge of the box for Osasuna. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
41' A player from Valencia commits a rough challenge. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
40' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
39' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
34' Pepelu (Valencia) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul.
31' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Valencia for a penalty. Play continues.
29' Valencia are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
26' The free kick from long range, taken by Valencia, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
22' A quickly taken corner by Osasuna.
22' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) gets on the end of the free kick, but somehow sends his header well wide of the right post from close in.
21' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias interrupts the game. One of the players from Valencia won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
20' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Osasuna is cautioned for aggressive play.
18' A corner kick by Valencia is thwarted by the well prepared Sergio Herrera (Osasuna).
16' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
9' Osasuna are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
6' Valencia take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
5' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) inside the box.
3' A cross from a corner kick by Osasuna is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
2' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Osasuna earn a corner.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Valencia will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
